If you haven't seen Dark City, close this tab and go watch it. It's a great movie. I will be discussing spoilers here.

Dark City came out before The Matrix, it's an amazing film, and it shares many similarities with The Matrix. I'm not the first person to notice this.

Murdock is basically The One. The Strangers are The Agents. Mr. Hand is like Agent Smith, Murdock's evil opposite. "Tuning", an ability which lets The Strangers physically change reality as they wish, combined with their manipulation of memories in the population of The City, is their Matrix. It is a system of control. Like The One, Murdock is helped to recognize this control. He masters the ability to manipulate reality and ultimately uses it in order to free the people trapped in The City following a climactic battle with The Strangers and his own out of control Smith-like adversary.

Where the films really differ is that The City is basically an experiment. The Strangers are looking for something they need to survive and they don't quite know what it is. In the case of The Matrix, The Machines already know what they need and are extracting it. But in both cases, the systems of control were built to get something from the people trapped within.
